title: Rapport intérimaire sur la vision, les orientations stratégiques et le plan d'action de la SNDS 2016-2020 (Version définitive)
why_not: Superseded cycle, and the only accessible copy is a document-relay mirror rather than a primary ONS or ANSADE publication. Scope drop: not-primary.

title: Textes régissant les systèmes statistiques nationaux
why_not: An index page listing loi n° 2005-017 and the CNS decrees rather than the texts themselves; the SNDDS baseline already carries the legal framework. Cap excluded.

title: Décret de création de l'ANSADE
why_not: The founding act of the statistics agency, not of the strategy; the SNDDS baseline states the same institutional position. Cap excluded.

title: Note Annuelle Sectorielle sur la Mise en Œuvre (NASMO) 2024
why_not: A sectoral implementation note that restates SNDDS continuity; adds nothing the baseline does not settle, and predates the window. Cap excluded.

title: Mauritania - World Bank Enterprise Survey 2025
why_not: A World Bank survey deposit rather than a movement of the Mauritanian statistical system; the two staged progress items are national operations. Cap excluded.

title: Bulletin de Suivi de la campagne agropastorale au Sahel et en Afrique de l'Ouest, juillet 2026
why_not: Fetched. Regional bulletin whose only Mauritanian content is desert-locust breeding conditions; no Mauritania-specific satellite finding. Scope drop: out-of-scope.

title: FAO GIEWS Country Brief on Mauritania
why_not: A continuously regenerated country page with no fixed dated body to stage; the agent's 9 September 2025 reference could not be pinned to a stable document. Scope drop: headline-only-stub.

title: Ateliers nationaux GMES, Mauritanie, 16-17-18 et 19 décembre 2024
publisher: Observatoire du Sahara et du Sahel
why_not: Earlier workshop in the same GMES series; the July 2025 page is the later and fuller statement of the same arrangement. Cap excluded.

title: Résumés des présentations
why_not: Research capacity and stated intent on remote sensing, NDVI and drones rather than an operating national service. Cap excluded.

title: Décret n° 28-99/PM fixant les attributions du Ministre du Développement Rural et de l'Environnement
why_not: Administrative attributions decree; it grounds agricultural statistics and cartography but says nothing about satellite data. Cap excluded.

title: Atelier sur le système d'alerte précoce agrométéorologique basé sur l'intelligence artificielle
why_not: Fetched. ONM/UNDP AI early-warning training at Rosso; the body nowhere states a satellite data input, so it does not evidence this indicator. Scope drop: out-of-scope.

title: À propos
why_not: Names the PUMA and AMESD reception systems but carries no date; the Strategic Plan states the same position with a date and detail. Cap excluded.

title: Plan d'action détaillé 2024-2030
why_not: The operational annex to the strategy already staged as baseline; planned radar and receivers, not installed capability. Cap excluded.

title: WMO Register of Alerting Authorities — Mauritania
why_not: Establishes ONM as the WMO alerting authority with a CAP feed, but is a register entry about warnings rather than about satellite data use. Cap excluded.

title: Warning Advisory System for Sand and Dust Storm in West Africa: Concept Note
why_not: A regional 16-country advisory system in which Mauritania participates; describes no Mauritanian instrument and carries no publication date. Cap excluded.

title: Décret de création de l'Office National de la Météorologie (ONM)
why_not: The founding act of the institution, silent on satellite data; the Strategic Plan is the on-point standing instrument. Cap excluded.

title: Mauritania Threshold Program Agreement
why_not: Would have been the preferred baseline as the signed instrument itself, but two fetch attempts returned CRAWL_LIVECRAWL_TIMEOUT. Scope drop: unfetchable.

title: Mauritania Threshold Program Agreement
why_not: Fetched, but the body is the MCC site's navigation chrome plus a link to the PDF; there is no document text to stage. Scope drop: headline-only-stub.

title: MCC, Mauritania Sign $27 Million Grant to Modernize Energy Sector and Boost Resilience
why_not: Fetched. The announcement of the instrument rather than the instrument, and dated before the progress window, so it can only compete for the baseline slot and loses to a signed MoU record. Cap excluded.

title: Le ministre de la Défense reçoit la chargée d'affaires par intérim de l'ambassade des États-Unis d'Amérique à Nouakchott
why_not: A courtesy meeting with no stated outcome, commitment or instrument; both staged progress items are completed activities. Cap excluded.

title: Mauritania Awards New Satellite Communications Licences to Strengthen National Connectivity
why_not: Checked because it was the only plausible hyperscaler route: the ARE tender of 22 January 2026 is limited to geostationary systems and the provisional awardees are BRAINSAT, VMD and Mattel. No US hyperscaler and no Starlink licence, so it does not bear on this indicator. Cap excluded.

title: Member Countries
why_not: Checked to test an India-led multilateral claim: Mauritania does not appear on the ISA member list, so the engagement cannot be coded from it. Scope drop: out-of-scope.

title: Le Président de la République, Président de l'Union africaine et la Présidente de la République de l'Inde supervisent la signature de plusieurs accords bilatéraux
why_not: The signing ceremony for the four 2024 instruments — outside the progress window, and the MEA brief states the same four with their entry-into-force dates. Cap excluded.

title: PRESIDENT OF INDIA VISITED MAURITANIA YESTERDAY
why_not: A second report of the same October 2024 event; the brief forbids two reports of one event and the MEA baseline already carries it. Cap excluded.

title: Bilateral Brief as on 09.10.2023
publisher: Ministry of External Affairs, Government of India
why_not: The superseded edition of the staged baseline; it records bilateral agreements as Nil and predates the 2024 instruments. Cap excluded.

title: 1st India – Mauritania Foreign Office Consultations (FOC)
publisher: Ministry of External Affairs, Government of India
why_not: The first FOC session, outside the window and already summarised in the staged baseline. Cap excluded.

title: Member Countries and Organizations
why_not: Confirms Mauritania as a CDRI member, an India-launched multilateral body, but is an undated membership list rather than an Indian engagement with a date. Cap excluded.

title: Cultural Exchange Programme
publisher: Ministry of Culture, Government of India
why_not: Institutional listing confirming the 2024-2028 CEP; a register entry, not the instrument, and the baseline names it. Cap excluded.
